dataList.content:
Ack... the stench won't come off. Who's that now?
咳……这臭味完全散不掉啊。那又是谁？

M-mister Domino!!!
多……多米诺先生！！！

Crayon, who'd been holding her breath with her fingers over her nostrils, ran up to the large man and hugged him.
刚刚还捏着鼻子忍受着臭味的柯蕾昂跑向了高大的男人并抱了上去。

At least you're safe, Crayon... That's good.
至少你没事，柯蕾昂……太好了。

Cough...
咳……

After stumbling for a moment(due to the stench, most likely), Outis briefly gasped for air before approaching Domino.
不知是否因为难忍的臭味，稍微有些踉跄的奥提斯呼出一口气，接近了叫多米诺的人。

Hey, you... Identify... yourself.
喂，表明……你的身份。

Name's Domino. I'm a monster Hunter from Cloud Town.
我是来自云之镇的怪物猎人，多米诺。

... I don't suppose I can call it a town anymore now that it's just me and Crayon that's left.
……不过云之镇的幸存者只剩我和柯蕾昂了，事到如今已经不能称之为小镇了吧。

Relax. I wouldn't even think of hurting any of you.
放心，我丝毫没有加害于你们的想法。

Haah... So you're the Hunter that the girl mentioned.
嗯……是之前这小鬼说过的猎人吗……

Outis relaxed upon Domino's confirmation. She leaned on a wall and looked to the floor in relief.
奥提斯终于放松了下来，靠着墙壁垂下了头。

Normally, around this time of year, these monsters would've gone further north to a different village...
本来在这个时期，这群家伙应该会去袭击北面的其他村子而不是来我们的小镇……

So I was on an expedition to help them out. ... Looks like they decided to switch things up this time around.
所以我为了帮助他们而出发……但这次它们的行动似乎改变了。

When I returned, they'd already finished their raid on our village and left... Damn it, they used to be predictable, attacking only right before Christmas.
回来的时候镇子已经被袭击了……妈的，它们本来总是在圣诞之前的准备期间来袭，因此比其他怪物容易避开。

... Do these tragedies happen often?
……这种事情多有发生吗？

Though I can't speak for the City, I can say that this is a common occurrence in the Outskirts. It's a hellish place to live, if you can even call this living. Survival alone is a miracle out here.
我不知道都市里面是什么样的，但郊区一直都是这副惨状……如同地狱一般。在满是怪物的这里有人存活本身就是一件奇迹。

Are there a lot more places out here like this... like this mockery of a gift factory?
制作这种……连礼物都算不上的东西的地方还有很多吗？

No, can't say I've seen a factory like this anywhere else. But I can tell you one thing.
虽然没有见过类似这里的地方……但有一点可以确定。

Compared to some worse things that could've happened... this tragedy was nothing. That's the natural order of things in the Outskirts.
和郊区发生的其他事情比起来，这里的情况还算可爱的。

I do wonder, sometimes. If we were in the City, no matter how bad it gets in there... it must be better than this living hell.
如果是在都市的话……应该会过上比在这种地狱里要更好的人生吧，我经常这样想。

It was no easy contemplation to answer. The Outskirts must be a hellish place to live, if what he's told me is anything to go by. But...
这十分难以回答。虽说郊区大概也存在着郊区独有的，我们无法想象的地狱……

... the City they admire so much... isn't such a warm place itself. ... From what I've seen in my journey so far, at least.
与他们的期望不同，都市并不是一个温馨的地方……至少，就我过去旅程中的所见所闻而言。

Aha! Then accompany us back to the City! We were on our—
若是如此！一同前往都市如何！吾等在此后……

Don Quixote stopped herself, realizing that every other Sinner was giving her a look of disapproval.
堂吉诃德虽然想继续话题，但仿佛感到了罪人们看向自己的叱责般的视线，就这样沉默了。

... Thank you for your kind words, at least.
……感谢你的美言。但……

I wish it were that easy. If I could at least let this child enter the City somehow, just like that...
就凭这样简单的一句话，是连这个孩子也带不到都市里去的吧。

But the City... has no place to spare for this child. Not even a small corner of it.
都市绝对……不会为这孩子留出哪怕小小一隅的位置。

Even if you were to somehow make it past the City's walls, there are countless variations of paperwork and procedure you must overcome before you can live the kind of life you desire.
想要越过都市的围墙，享受各位梦想中的人生，只是必要的准备文件和手续就有数十种吧。

Ha ha... And what would people like us even do with such paperwork? And where would we find them out here? We've not studied or worked to find a job in the City as some youths of other villages do.
文件吗……你认为我们现在有任何可以准备的文件吗？我们没有像其他镇子的青年们一样为了在都市里找到工作而学习过……

Mister...
大叔……

There was an uncomfortable silence. Domino cleared his throat and continued.
尴尬的沉默持续了一段时间，多米诺清了清嗓子将话题继续下去。

I must still extend my gratitude for keeping the girl safe until my arrival.
不过还是对你们表示感谢。多亏你们才至少能救出这孩子。

I know a good way to, cough, extend your gratitude. Maybe you can extend us a nice pouch of shiny and jangling bag of...
表达感谢的最好方法是有的……咳，虽说是有的。闪闪亮亮的……咳，能响起清脆的声音的……

Rodion's eyes were twinkling. The lingering stench made it difficult for her to speak, but she was determined to make her point.
罗佳虽然看上去十分辛苦，但她眼里闪烁着一定要说出来的决心。

Hmm... Something shiny and jangling? Sure, maybe I can give you a tour of some antique items I keep at home...
嗯……闪亮清脆？我可以给你们一些家里收集的不错的古董……

Precious items salvaged from the locomotive tracks of the Outskirts. Not something you'll see every day in the City, I'm sure.
毕竟是经由郊区的铁轨收集的珍贵品，应该有就算在都市里也十分罕见的东西吧。

Items from the Outskirts... that tour alone could be worth much more than just pure cash.
郊区的收集品的话……听上去确实是比金钱要有价值的东西。

<Faust... there's still a decent chance that the door we entered through might just shut behind us, right?>
<浮士德……我们进入的门扉会关闭的概率还是很高吧？>

Indeed. In fact, it is unclear whether the door is still open. I recommend a quick return to the bus, now that our two primary objectives have been secured.
是的。就算现在也不确定门是否还开着。由于最重要的目标是这两名罪人的回收，我推荐迅速返程。

<... So she says.>
<……她是这样说的，各位。>

If you would permit me to speak my mind, Executive Manager. Even if this is not the Great Lake... the Outskirts is an extremely perilous place. This curiosity cannot be a reason for us to risk getting stranded in this environment.
执行经理，恕我僭越，即使此处不是大湖，郊区就是郊区。如果仅因满足好奇心就长时间呆在这里，过于危险了。

Looks like you've got to hurry back... Well, then! Catch!
看来你们必须要赶紧回去了……那么！把这个带走吧！

Domino tossed a carved wooden doll in my direction.
多米诺向我投来了一个木雕人偶。

It does not appear to be anything dangerous. Let us inspect it further after we return. We mustn't dally any longer than we have to.
看上去不是危险的东西……首先我们必须赶紧返程，细节还是回去之后再确认吧。

<Yeah, g-good idea!>
<啊、是、是啊！>

Some Sinners had passed out and had to be carried by others. Most could not stop gagging at the stench. But we still made our way back to the door...
罪人们或因昏迷而被搬运，或不断忍受着恶心，沿着来时的路返回……

The door has remained open...!
现在门尚开着……！

We made it back to the safety of Mephistopheles.
我们平安回到了梅菲斯托费勒斯上。

Some time later...
不久之后……

Boo. Stinky. Charon, evacuate. Evacuate.
呜。味道好臭。卡戎躲开躲开。
dataList.place:
Cabins of Mephistopheles
梅菲斯托费勒斯 船舱

dataList.content:
Charon quickly made her escape to the decks...
卡戎逃似的冲向了甲板……

... And Vergilius greeted us in the cabins with a terrifying gaze.
留在船舱里的维吉里乌斯，用仿佛要杀了我们般的视线盯着我们。

Looks like everyone's had quite the adventure.
各位，看来从无比精彩的冒险中归来了啊。

Covered in blood and guts... and with a disgusting stench to boot.
身上覆盖着血肉……带着恶心的臭味回来真是一番好光景。

<Oh, this is...>
<啊，这是……>

... Manager. I can't hear you anyway.
……经理。反正我也听不到你的声音……

So just reply to my query with a nod or a shake.
点头或是摇头，能这样对我进行回复的话不胜感激。

Your replies better match up with my expectations, of course.
当然，是用我所希望的回复。

I have but one question.
想问的事情只有一个。

... Was it you who made the call?
……这次是你下的判断吗？

I hesitated for a moment before nodding affirmatively.
……我虽然有些迷惑，但还是立刻点了点头。

I might get reprimanded. Or maybe he has worse things in mind for me. But...
虽然可能会就这样被问责，甚至发生更严重的事……

... it was I who decided to go along with their plan. This would not have happened without my authorization.
确实我当时应该阻止那两个人，我却同意了执行他们的计划。

... Good. Then my questioning is over.
……很好。这样我的质问就结束了。

Huh?
嗯？

I will leave it to you to deal with this mess. You may rest afterward. And please, do something about this foul stench.
自己解决这摊子骚乱后再去休息。另外把这股能把鼻子都熏烂了的味道也排干净。

Well, then.
就这样。

With that, Vergilius disappeared into the Backdoor once again.
维吉里乌斯说完这些话，再次进入后门消失了。

<Huh. That's unexpected. I thought my time had finally come.>
<真没想到……我还以为肯定会被拉去面谈呢。>

Be glad! The best consultation is a consultation not had, indeed...
那不是很好嘛！不被面谈总是好的……

Alas! Behold, one and all!
比起那些！大家快来看看这里！

I don't know when she had the time to pick it up in all that chaos, but Don Quixote managed to haul a huge sack of gifts back to Mephistopheles.
堂吉诃德拆开了一个巨大的礼物包，虽然我不知道她是什么时候把这些礼物从那场骚乱中带回巴士的。

You picked that up from all that mess?
这些是你趁着那场乱七八糟的骚乱拿回来的？

I have laid claim upon the evil gnomes' trinkets!
那些坏矮人用来做装饰的灯串。全都被吾扯下来了！

Now that's some real commitment...
真厉害……你那执念，说真的……

<What's all that for?>
<要用那些做什么？>

Ah, art thou truly unaware of mine intentions?! 'Tis for adorning our ship with Christmas decorations!
真的不知道吗！圣诞节装饰呀！

Wait, now? But we're still, like, three months away from Christmas...
这么早……？距离圣诞节还有3个多月呢……

Agreed. Let us not risk peeling old wounds. To lower the morale of our company is...
……肆无忌惮地揭开某人的伤疤，这种降低士气的行为是……

Oh, it's... okay. It's been getting better with time. Little by little.
啊，没事的……已经稍微，不那么介意了。

Yeah. We can all grow beyond it. Eventually.
因为大家都成长了呢。

Mmhm~ Marvelous!
嗯~太棒了！

Then this appears to be an occasion most fit for a PAR-TAY then! What say you?!
从这个意义上来说！今天让吾等提前享受派对如何！

Don't tell me you went through all that trouble for some party decorations...?
你不会是专门为了做这事而跑去那里的吧……？

According to Dante's explanations, this incident was spurred on by Heathcliff's need for an outfit.
按照但丁的说明，这场骚乱的核心……是为了获得希斯克利夫先生的衣服这件事。

Heathcliff has been silently brooding in his seat with his face buried in his palms. Out of shame, most likely.
希斯克利夫似乎从刚才就被羞愧感折磨着，只抱着头坐在椅子上。

A-ahem. Verily, verily. Yet... that very costume we had sought was worn by none other than that monstrous giant...
呃，嗯。那也没错……但是想找的服装穿在那个巨人身上……

I-I don't suppose it would fit Sir Heathcliff, anyhow...
尺、尺寸也！好像不合适……

Forget it... It wasn't the kind of look I was going for, anyway.
算了……反正也不是我想象中的那种衣服。

What did I say, Heath...? We'll help ya out as soon as we land, 'kay...?
希斯……所以说一回陆地，我们都会帮你挑的……

The outfit's one thing, yeah. But the... uh...
衣服先不谈……还有那个……

You are speaking of the portship we sailed past. The portship on which the hair salon that printed those hair coupons conducts their business.
是指我们途经的港船发行的发廊优惠券吗。

The coupons could not be used, as the portship was not on our charted route.
与航路相背，不具备可使用的条件。

Leave it to me to style your hair. I've done my sisters' and younger siblings' hair pretty often.
头发就让我来吧。以前我经常帮姐姐和弟弟们理发。

We don't know how long we'll be floating on this damn lake, anyway! B-besides...
鬼知道还要在这里漂流多久！而、而且……

... I don't even know how to dress myself proper. I was going to attempt the trial-and-error method.
……我根本就不知道什么样的才合适。就只能从试错中慢慢找到更好的方法。

Okay, but can you at least tell us what it is that Vergilius gave you? Just so that we know what exactly you're so anxious about.
说到底，你到底收到了什么才会变得这么不安？

... Hah. Sod it.
……哈，随便吧。

After a deep, heavy sigh, Heathcliff produced...
重重地叹了口气后，希斯克利夫从怀里拿出来的是……

<... A letter?>
<信？>

So that's the... 'something' Vergilius gave you?
所以这就是……他给你的那东西？

Ohh~ I remember! My family's used this envelope before. It's made from really expensive paper, made only in limited quantities at a time. It's quite a luxurious envelope.
哦~我记得这些信封和信纸，我们家里曾经也使用过。这都是由最高级的纸张制成的，产量很少呢。

Can we read it? Heath?
我们能读一下吗？希斯……

Sure. It's nothing impressive.
行，反正没什么大不了的。

Then Dante, why don't you read it out loud for the rest of us~?
那么……但丁来读吧~毕竟是我们的代表！

<S-sure.>
<哦、哦。>

Rodya handed me the letter. It was written in a beautiful series of cursive handwriting, drawn to an almost calligraphic perfection.
罗佳递给我的信上，写着如同刺绣般娟秀的手写笔迹……

I began reading.
我开始读里面写的内容。

From Wuthering Heights.
来自呼啸山庄。

We cordially extend you, honoured guest, an invitation to the ■■■■■.
诚邀您访问■■■■■。

<Uh... What's this here? Somebody colored over this part of the letter.>
<呃……这上面写的是什么？被涂掉了，看不清楚……>

<... Well, I'll keep reading.>
<……总之，我先继续读。>

Venue: Wuthering Heights, T Corp. Nest.
地点在T公司巢的呼啸山庄。

Should you accept our invitation, please convene at the designated location by four in the afternoon on the 24th with this letter on your person.
如果您接受邀请，请于24日16点前携此邀请函入场。

Please, honour this occasion with your presence.
敬请光临，您的到来必令寒舍蓬荜生辉。

With great respect,
谨启，

Nelly.
耐莉。

<Oh, and down here's a... postscript. It's written in a different handwriting from the rest of the letter...>
<哦，还有一句笔迹不同的附言……>

<color=#4e3876>P.S. You have to be here, Heath. I'll be waiting. - Cathy.</color=#4e3876>
<color=#4e3876>ps. 绝对要来哦，希斯。我会等着你的。——凯茜</color=#4e3876>

We had no way to tell what kind of 'occasion' it was on account of it being colored over, but...
因为有人把字迹抹去了，所以我们很难分辨具体是什么活动……

... clearly, the rest of the letter's contents had stoked the fire of passion in Heathcliff's heart once again.
很显然，那封信的内容再度燃起了希斯克利夫的热忱。

So...
所以……

You gotta look fashionable and classy for this Cathy person... right?
你是想好好打扮给这位凯茜看……是吗？

Well, yeah. But there's more to it than—
不能说不是，但也不止……

Shh. Quiet now.
嘘，安静。

Now I can clearly see why you were so impatient, 'Heath'.
我现在终于知道你为什么等得这么着急了……“希·斯”。

Huh?! Why are you lookin' at me like that? Oi?!
什么？干嘛用那种眼神看我？喂？！

I'll leave it up to you to style his hair, master hairdresser Hong Lu.
鸿璐老师，打理发型的事情就交给你了。

Huhu, I wouldn't call myself a master.
呼呼，我倒是不会自称老师啦。

Oi, wait! W-where are you taking me? Guh, what in the bloody hell is this grip—
等等！你、你要带我去哪儿？！诶这，好大的劲……

Mmhm, yeah. Rodya's got quite the grip strength... You won't free yourself from her anytime soon.
嗯哼。罗佳小姐的手劲确实很大……就别想着能脱身了。

The two Sinners, practically hauling Heathcliff by his arms, disappeared into the Backdoor.
希斯克利夫基本是被那两位罪人扛在肩上，一起消失进了巴士后门。

Now, Heathcliff's fate was sealed. To be a mannequin to a now motivated(and unbearably bored) Rodya's various experimentations...
也许是看了信之后懂了些什么（也有可能是太无聊了），罗佳大概会把他当作换装人偶来玩弄吧……

Ah, I can hang this trinket here, and... hmm hmm~
吾可以把这些挂饰都挂起来……哼哼~

Don Quixote began humming a song—a carol, perhaps—as she placed the various trinkets around the bus.
堂吉诃德一边着手装饰巴士，一边轻哼起圣诞颂歌来。

I decided to go out to the deck for some air...
我打算到甲板上去走一会儿……

I leaned on the railing and dug through my pockets.
我微微靠着栏杆，翻找着口袋。
dataList.place:
Aboard Mephistopheles's Deck
梅菲斯托费勒斯 甲板

dataList.content:
... The wooden doll Domino the Hunter gave me just as we hurriedly left.
从口袋里掏出来的是那个名叫多米诺的猎人匆忙扔给我的木雕人偶。

I held it and felt its texture under my fingers. My eyes looked into the distance, toward where the Outskirts lie.
我摆弄着它，望向远处可能是郊区的地方。

I thought for a moment about the gnomes, the giant, and the things Domino told me.
小矮人和巨人，还有多米诺说过的话在我的脑中挥之不去。

<I suppose there are people with stories in the Outskirts, too.>
<在郊区也有着各种各样的人生吧。>

<Stories, different from those of the City...>
<和都市中不同的人生……>

Faust approached from behind and stood next to me. I wasn't sure how much of what I said she heard.
浮士德不知从何时开始旁听，走过来站在了我的身边。

Follow the stars, Dante. Star by star. Then... you will one day learn.
只要一个个地去追寻星星，你总有一天会明白的，但丁。

So for now, follow the closest star that shines before your eyes.
所以现在，首先去追求眼前的星星就好。

Yeah.
嗯。

I have to focus on the stories of the City for now.
现在集中在都市里发生的事情上就已经尽全力了。

I don't even know who I really am, after all.
毕竟我还处于连自己是谁都想不起来的状态。

Joyous laughter and frustrated howls echoed out of the cabins. They must've finished dressing up Heathcliff.
船舱里希斯克利夫的形象转换貌似完成了，可以听到愤怒的咆哮以及愉快的笑声。

<... Why don't we go take a look at how Heathcliff is doing, Faust?>
<……要不要一起去看看希斯克利夫变得怎么样了，浮士德？>

You make a rather tempting offer, Dante.
这真是一个十分有吸引力的提案。

The added color to the Bus's interior warmed my heart a little.
在比起之前变得五颜六色了一些的巴士内，我感到了一丝丝温暖。
